objective: Make the dispatch-bash.sh and ticket-first gates fail closed with timeouts taken from a recorded per-hook timing profile, document and test the disableAllHooks launch override as the escape hatch, and validate the plugin marketplace in CI.
why: The reconciliation finds all four o1 criteria not-verified. No hook entry in .claude/settings.json sets onFailure and only line 107 sets a timeout, so a crashed or hung gate lets the tool call through. Inside dispatch-bash.sh run_hook (lines 59-80) turns any sub-gate exit other than 2 into a WARN, so a crashed ticket-first gate also fails open there. The four merge gates already fail closed through run_merge_gate_hook (#1403). .claude-plugin/marketplace.json has no description, so claude plugin validate --strict fails today, and no workflow runs it. o2 and o3 add more gates, so the gate failure mode must be fixed first.

include: Profile 50 or more dispatch-bash.sh and ticket-first calls with claude --debug and record p50 p95 and max in docs/perf/
Set onFailure block on the dispatch-bash.sh and require-active-ticket.sh entries with a timeout of at least 5 x p95 and never under 10 s
Route ticket-first inside dispatch-bash.sh through the fail-closed path the merge gates use
Record the minimum Claude Code version for onFailure (v2.1.295) and what older clients do with the field
Document claude --settings with disableAllHooks true as the operator escape hatch and add a CI test that hooks are on by default and off under the override
Add a CI step with a pinned Claude Code version that runs claude plugin validate --strict on .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
exclude: onFailure changes on hooks other than dispatch-bash.sh and ticket-first
The settings.json wrapper exit 0 when no .claude/hooks directory is found (deliberate for non-ApexYard directories)
Codex and Cursor adapters (o2 and o3)
